correctness.rationale: All 2640 tournaments generated independently by full mask enumeration and outgoing-score recursion; a parity derived from seven exact score equations reduces 21 coordinates to 15. Independent projection-support transforms give 91381760/2097152=1427840/32768=11155/256. Translation averaging proves unrestricted projection minimality. Scope is exactly K7, no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Seven vertices is the first size with more than one regular tournament isomorphism type (three rather than a single type at three/five vertices), making it a canonical finite structural benchmark. Exact full indicator-convolution rank and Fourier gap distinguish recoverability from simple tournament counts/first-degree covariance, while 11155/256 gives an exact globally sharp Banach projection-stability invariant. The six-coordinate parity quotient explains the natural computational reduction and shows the evaluated invariant is not just a standard unsigned count.
